answer_1.quote: Therefore, in this work, we aim to build an interpretable emotional support dialogue system.

answer_2.quote: We apply three commonly used automatic evaluation metrics, BLEU-n, ROUGE-L (Lin, 2004); and Distinct-n.

answer_4.quote: We recruit 3 professional annotators to evaluate randomly selected 50 responses of different settings from the Coherence, Informativeness, and Empathy aspects with the levels of {0,1,2}.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluate responses on Coherence, Informativeness, Empathy (0-2 scale) and Accuracy of strategy consistency.
